instructions.name: accept
docs: Freelancer accepts the brief (by its hash) and fixes where the earnings go: own wallet, or an allowlisted payout partner + reference

instructions.name: accept_cancel
docs: The other party accepts the split; the expected values must match the current proposal

accounts.name: signer
docs: The party that did not propose (checked in the handler)

instructions.name: add_device_key
docs: Registers one device key (no change if it is already registered)

instructions.name: apply_job
docs: Applies to an open job with a public pitch (one application per person)

accounts.name: freelancer
docs: Pays the rent of the application

instructions.name: approve
docs: Client approves a submitted (or disputed) milestone: release to the destination

instructions.name: close
docs: Creator closes a never-funded or settled contract; leftover → client, rent → rent_payer

instructions.name: concede
docs: Freelancer concedes a disputed milestone: refund to the client

instructions.name: create_fund
docs: Client creates a contract: 1–5 milestones, each with an amount, a submission deadline and a review deadline

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of the fund and the vault (may be the client)

instructions.name: create_profile
docs: Tạo hồ sơ: NameRecord [b"name", username] + ReverseRecord [b"reverse", wallet]

instructions.name: dispute
docs: Client disputes a submitted milestone before its review deadline (blocks auto-release)

instructions.name: fund_job
docs: v1.4 (D29): locks the budget of a "locks when hired" job (same transaction as create_fund + select_job)

instructions.name: init_device_keys
docs: Creates the wallet's empty device-key list (sent with the first add_device_key)

instructions.name: link_phone
docs: Liên kết SĐT: PhoneRecord [b"phone_v1", phone_key]. phone_key = scrypt(SĐT E.164) tính trong app —
program không bao giờ nhận hay lưu SĐT dạng rõ.

instructions.name: lock
docs: Client locks the full contract amount in the vault

instructions.name: lock_from_job
docs: Moves the job budget into the accepted contract (same transaction, after accept)

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone (the freelancer in practice)

instructions.name: post_job
docs: Publishes a job and locks its whole budget in the job vault

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of the listing and the job vault (may be the business)

instructions.name: post_job_brief
docs: One part of the job's plain-text brief (no state change), while the job is Open

accounts.name: job
docs: Read-only: listed so the brief can be found with getSignaturesForAddress(job)

instructions.name: post_job_open
docs: v1.4 (D29): publishes a job that locks its budget when the business selects someone (nothing locked now)

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of the listing and the job vault (may be the business)

instructions.name: post_note
docs: Posts one part of an encrypted brief (client, while Created), delivery (freelancer, Submitted milestone) or,
from v1.2, key note (either party, wraps of the contract key for registered devices).
No state change; the app reads it back from the transaction (v1.1)

accounts.name: fund
docs: Read-only: listed so notes can be found with getSignaturesForAddress(fund)

instructions.name: propose_cancel
docs: Client or freelancer proposes a split of what is still locked

accounts.name: signer
docs: Must be the fund's client or freelancer (checked in the handler: NotAParty)

instructions.name: refund
docs: Anyone refunds a milestone not submitted by its submission deadline

instructions.name: release_after_review
docs: Anyone releases a submitted milestone after its review deadline

instructions.name: remove_device_key
docs: Removes one device key

instructions.name: select_job
docs: Binds the job to the contract just created for one applicant (same transaction, after create_fund)

instructions.name: submit
docs: Freelancer marks a milestone delivered; `evidence` = SHA-256 of the canonical delivery JSON (never all zero)

instructions.name: transfer_stablecoin
docs: Chuyển Stablecoin (SPL Token / Token 2022) an toàn qua CPI TransferChecked

instructions.name: unlink_phone
docs: Huỷ liên kết SĐT: đóng PhoneRecord của chính mình (hoàn rent về signer)

accounts.name: phone_record
docs: PhoneRecord của chính signer (Account<> kiểm tra owner = program + discriminator)

instructions.name: update_username
docs: Đổi username: đóng NameRecord cũ (hoàn rent), tạo NameRecord mới, cập nhật ReverseRecord

accounts.name: old_name_record
docs: NameRecord hiện tại — đóng và hoàn rent về signer

instructions.name: withdraw_job
docs: Returns the budget to the business when no one was hired

errors.name: InvalidUsername
errors.msg: Username must be 3-20 characters: lowercase letters, digits or underscore.

errors.name: UsernameTaken
errors.msg: This username is already taken.

errors.name: ProfileAlreadyExists
errors.msg: This wallet already has a profile.

errors.name: SameUsername
errors.msg: The new username is the same as the current one.

errors.name: NotNameOwner
errors.msg: Only the owner of this username can change it.

errors.name: PhoneTaken
errors.msg: This phone number is already linked to another N.E.D account.

errors.name: PhoneAlreadyLinked
errors.msg: This wallet already has a linked phone number. Unlink it first.

errors.name: NotPhoneOwner
errors.msg: Only the wallet that linked this phone number can unlink it.

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Token amount must be greater than 0.

errors.name: InvalidMilestoneCount
errors.msg: A contract needs 1 to 5 milestones.

errors.name: AmountTooLarge
errors.msg: The contract total is above the maximum amount.

errors.name: InvalidDeadline
errors.msg: A deadline is not valid.

errors.name: ReviewWindowTooShort
errors.msg: The review deadline must be at least the minimum review window after the submission deadline.

errors.name: WorkWindowTooShort
errors.msg: Too little time is left before the first submission deadline.

errors.name: SameParty
errors.msg: The client and the freelancer must be different wallets.

errors.name: InvalidFreelancer
errors.msg: The freelancer address is not valid.

errors.name: TitleTooLong
errors.msg: The title is longer than 32 bytes.

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: Only devnet USDC is accepted.

errors.name: InvalidFundState
errors.msg: The contract is not in the right state for this action.

errors.name: InvalidPayoutKind
errors.msg: Choose where the earnings go.

errors.name: InvalidPayoutDestination
errors.msg: This payout destination is not allowed for this choice.

errors.name: PayoutPartnerNotAllowed
errors.msg: This payout partner is not on the allowlist.

errors.name: InvalidPayoutReference
errors.msg: The payout reference is missing or not allowed for this choice.

errors.name: MilestoneIndexOutOfRange
errors.msg: This milestone does not exist in the contract.

errors.name: InvalidMilestoneStatus
errors.msg: The milestone is not in the right state for this action.

errors.name: DeadlinePassed
errors.msg: The deadline for this action has passed.

errors.name: DeadlineNotReached
errors.msg: The deadline has not passed yet.

errors.name: NotAParty
errors.msg: Only the client or the freelancer can do this.

errors.name: NoCancelProposal
errors.msg: There is no cancel proposal.

errors.name: CannotAcceptOwnProposal
errors.msg: The other party must accept the proposal.

errors.name: CancelAmountTooLarge
errors.msg: The proposed amount is larger than what is still locked.

errors.name: CancelProposalChanged
errors.msg: The cancel proposal changed. Review it again.

errors.name: FundNotClosable
errors.msg: This contract cannot be closed now.

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow.

errors.name: InvalidBriefHash
errors.msg: The brief fingerprint is missing.

errors.name: BriefMismatch
errors.msg: The brief changed. Read the brief again before accepting.

errors.name: InvalidEvidence
errors.msg: The delivery fingerprint is missing.

errors.name: InvalidNote
errors.msg: The note is empty, too long or has wrong part numbers.

errors.name: NoteNotAllowed
errors.msg: This note cannot be added now.

errors.name: DeviceKeysFull
errors.msg: This wallet already has the maximum number of devices. Remove one first.

errors.name: DeviceKeyNotFound
errors.msg: This device is not registered for this wallet.

errors.name: InvalidDeviceKey
errors.msg: The device key is not valid.

errors.name: JobNotOpen
errors.msg: This job is not open.

errors.name: ApplyClosed
errors.msg: Applications for this job are closed.

errors.name: SelectClosed
errors.msg: The time to select an applicant has passed.

errors.name: AcceptWindowOpen
errors.msg: The selected freelancer can still accept. Try again after the accept window.

errors.name: JobFundMismatch
errors.msg: This contract does not match the job.

errors.name: NotSelected
errors.msg: No applicant is selected for this job, or this is not the selected contract.

errors.name: WithdrawTooEarly
errors.msg: The budget cannot be withdrawn yet.

errors.name: PitchTooLong
errors.msg: The pitch is longer than 280 bytes.

errors.name: InvalidJobDeadlines
errors.msg: The job deadlines are not valid.

errors.name: InvalidCategory
errors.msg: The job category is not valid.

errors.name: SummaryTooLong
errors.msg: The job summary must be 1 to 160 bytes.

errors.name: JobNotFunded
errors.msg: The budget of this job is not locked yet. Lock it in the same step as selecting.

errors.name: JobAlreadyFunded
errors.msg: The budget of this job is already locked.

types.name: DeviceKeyAdded
docs: v1.2: a device key was registered for `wallet`

types.name: DeviceKeyRemoved
docs: v1.2: a device key was removed from `wallet`

types.name: DeviceKeys
docs: [b"device_keys", wallet] → X25519 public keys of the wallet's devices (v1.2, key-sync Plan C).
A contract's key is wrapped for each of these keys in a `post_note` of kind 2; the private keys never leave
the devices. `keys[..count]` are in use; the rest are zero.

types.name: JobApplication
docs: PDA [JOB_APP_SEED, job, freelancer]; 364 bytes with the discriminator. One per person per job.

fields.name: job
docs: memcmp "applicants of a job" (offset 9)

fields.name: freelancer
docs: memcmp "my applications" (offset 41)

fields.name: pitch
docs: UTF-8, zero-padded; public

types.name: JobFunded
docs: v1.4 (D29): the budget of a "locks when hired" listing moved into its job vault (sent with create_fund + select_job)

types.name: JobListing
docs: PDA [JOB_SEED, business, job_id.to_le_bytes()]; 576 bytes with the discriminator

fields.name: state
docs: memcmp "open jobs" (offset 9)

fields.name: business
docs: memcmp "my listings" (offset 10)

fields.name: category
docs: Index into the @ned/core taxonomy (< JOB_CATEGORY_COUNT); memcmp "jobs in this category" (offset 42)

fields.name: skills
docs: Bitmask of up to 64 skills from the same taxonomy (filtered in the browser)

fields.name: apply_by
docs: Last time to apply

fields.name: select_by
docs: Last time to select; withdraw opens after it

fields.name: total
docs: Sum of the template amounts; the job vault holds exactly this (plus any donation)

fields.name: milestones
docs: MAX_MILESTONES slots (literal so the IDL gets a plain array length); slots >= milestone_count stay zeroed

fields.name: title
docs: UTF-8, zero-padded; searched

fields.name: summary
docs: UTF-8, zero-padded; the card text; not part of the brief hash

fields.name: brief_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the canonical brief JSON (same canonicalBrief as contracts); never all zero

fields.name: selected
docs: Default until select_job

fields.name: fund
docs: The contract created at select; memcmp "job of this contract" (offset 508)

fields.name: unfunded
docs: v1.4 (D29, lock-at-hire-plan.md): 1 = "locks when hired" (post_job_open; nothing locked yet), 0 = the budget is
in the job vault (post_job, or after fund_job). Every v1.3 listing reads 0. memcmp "funded only" (offset 544)

types.name: JobMilestone
docs: One milestone of the job template (24 bytes). The contract's absolute deadlines are set at select time.

fields.name: work_secs
docs: The submission deadline is this long after select

fields.name: review_secs
docs: review_by − submit_by of the contract milestone

types.name: JobMilestoneInput
docs: `post_job` argument (24 bytes)

types.name: JobPostedOpen
docs: v1.4 (D29): a listing that locks its budget when the business selects someone. `total` is the planned budget;
nothing is locked yet.

types.name: Milestone
docs: One milestone slot (65 bytes)

fields.name: submitted_at
docs: 0 until submitted

fields.name: evidence
docs: SHA-256 of the canonical delivery JSON (links, file fingerprints, note), computed by the app; never all zero

types.name: MilestoneInput
docs: `create_fund` argument (24 bytes)

types.name: MilestoneReleased
docs: The payout partner matches a deposit to a recipient by this event (`payout_reference`)

types.name: NameRecord
docs: [b"name", username] → ví sở hữu username

types.name: NotePosted
docs: An encrypted brief or delivery note was posted (v1.1); the ciphertext is in the instruction data only

types.name: PhoneRecord
docs: [b"phone_v1", scrypt(SĐT)] → ví đã liên kết SĐT (chưa xác minh OTP)

types.name: ReverseRecord
docs: [b"reverse", wallet] → hồ sơ công khai của ví (người quay lại = có ReverseRecord)

types.name: SharedFund
docs: PDA [FUND_SEED, creator, fund_id.to_le_bytes()]; 740 bytes with the discriminator

fields.name: client
docs: memcmp filter "as client" (offset 12)

fields.name: freelancer
docs: memcmp filter "as freelancer" (offset 44)

fields.name: creator
docs: PDA seed; equals `client` in v1

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Receives the rent of the fund and the vault on `close`

fields.name: payout_destination
docs: A wallet (ATA owner), never a token account; default until `accept`

fields.name: total
docs: Sum of milestone amounts

fields.name: milestones
docs: MAX_MILESTONES slots (literal so the IDL gets a plain array length); slots >= milestone_count stay zeroed and are ignored

fields.name: cancel_proposer
docs: default = no proposal

fields.name: title
docs: UTF-8, zero-padded

fields.name: payout_reference
docs: PayoutPartner only: hash of the partner's recipient ID; zero for OwnWallet

fields.name: brief_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the canonical brief JSON (offset 676), computed by the app; never all zero (v1.1)
